notes.scope: Equipable character armor with a documented chest or leg slot. Excludes raft defenses, weapons, classes as primary rows, cosmetics, and inferred set bonuses.
notes.normalization: Source values written as reduced damage taken are displayed as the equivalent damage-reduction percentage. No combined chest-plus-leg total is inferred.
notes.knownGap: Military Armor is documented as a Soldier Level 2 unlock, but its effect remains TBA in the primary source.
notes.imagePolicy: Eleven dedicated row-identifiable equipment crops from the primary guide are wired. Knight Armor, Alien Chest, Military Armor, Alien Legs, and Wooden Legs remain null because the available media are class portraits or no dedicated file exists.

item.name: Knight Armor
item.howToGet: Choose the Knight class; this armor is exclusive to that class.
item.notes: The strongest confirmed single-piece reduction in the current roster.
item.cardSummary: Knight-only chest armor with 30% damage reduction for tank-focused runs.

item.name: Diamond Chest
item.howToGet: Open chests; the primary armor guide does not publish a more specific drop table.
item.cardSummary: Chest-loot armor with 20% damage reduction and no documented secondary bonus.

item.name: Alien Chest
item.howToGet: Start as Alien Warrior, or complete the Dynamite Alien Island objective and claim its armor reward.
item.sourceLocation: Alien Warrior loadout; Dynamite Alien Island
item.notes: The island route is independently corroborated by an Alien Invasion walkthrough.
item.cardSummary: Alien chest gear pairs 15% damage reduction with 15% more max HP and has both class and island routes.
